cloudNative.title: Cloud Native
cloudNative.text1: Cloud Native is an approach that considers scalability and flexibility in developing, deploying, and managing applications in a cloud computing environment. It supports tools and technologies that enable efficient application development using cloud infrastructure. In particular, Cloud Native technologies allow the rapid deployment of various applications without affecting user service usage.
cloudNative.text2: PopcornSAR has built its development tools and platform using Cloud Native, ensuring that developers have the same experience no matter the environment they access. This is referred to as Cloud Native Automotive Software, and PopcornSAR covers all aspects of DevOps that align with Cloud Native Automotive Software to support efficient AA development.
cloudNative.text3: As a result, from a user perspective, there are advantages in terms of cost savings over the long term, as there is no need to build physical infrastructure, and the ability to use resources flexibly during the required periods. Additionally, by configuring ARM 64-based Virtual ECUs, AA testing can be performed in an environment identical to the actual Target ECU, significantly reducing development barriers and meeting the requirements of the SDV paradigm shift in building the App ecosystem.
cloudNative.text4: PopcornSAR's Cloud Native utilizes AWS (Amazon Web Services) resources, enabling the provision of stable services. It can also flexibly respond to customer demands by expanding resources in case of service interruptions due to feature updates or sudden increases in usage, thereby providing a positive customer experience.

digitalTwin.title: Digital Twin
digitalTwin.text1: As the era of SDV (Software-defined Vehicle) approaches, various functionalities that will be applied to future vehicles require a simulation environment such as a Digital Twin, based on data related to vehicle system performance and operating conditions, to perform tests under conditions identical to those of actual vehicles.
digitalTwin.text2: The reason for this is that, to realize SDVs, it is crucial to monitor and perform pre-implementation checks to ensure that functionality safety, the most critical aspect, is not adversely affected before actual production of vehicles.
digitalTwin.text3: Digital Twin also plays a significant role from the perspective of Adaptive AUTOSAR development. One of the biggest advantages is that, due to the visual nature of Digital Twins, it becomes easier to verify the functionality of AAs (Adaptive Applications) developed based on Adaptive AUTOSAR. This, in turn, facilitates development, debugging, error correction, and more. Through early issue detection, SW development, maintenance, and improvement tasks can be performed efficiently.
digitalTwin.text4: PopcornSAR's key product, AA (Adaptive Application) developed based on Adaptive AUTOSAR, is integrated with the Digital Twin developed by our partner company MORAI, enabling the implementation of various autonomous driving technologies, from basic control to advanced capabilities in vehicles.

ai.title: AI for Adaptive Platforms
ai.text1: PopcornSAR provides support for migrating AI models to Adaptive Applications (AAs) while considering integration with AI-specific open-source frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch.
ai.text2: When migrating complex AI models implemented with TensorFlow to AAs, issues can arise. Some problems include lower compiler versions in AI SDKs that incorporate PyTorch modules provided by semiconductor companies, lack of support for certain functionalities required for Adaptive AUTOSAR, and mismatches with the essential C++ version for Adaptive AUTOSAR, resulting in compilation and operational issues for AAs.
ai.text3: To address these challenges, PopcornSAR modifies its Adaptive AUTOSAR Stack to align with the compiler version used by AI. We provide a proprietary SOME/IP module implemented in Python to enable integration between AI implemented in Python and control-oriented AAs. Additionally, PopcornSAR offers support to develop Python-based AI into C++ based Adaptive AUTOSAR AI once AI model validation is complete, integrating the Adaptive AUTOSAR Stack into existing AI SDKs.
ai.text4: Furthermore, we also provide an ARM-based Docker container virtual ECU that operates on the ARM development board and development PC without modifying the logic of AI models implemented in Python.
ai.note: ※ Examples of PopcornSAR's solutions and AI integration: NXP's S32G2 and eIQ-AUTO (AI SDK)

company.title: About Us
company.description1: Today, automobiles have transformed into mobility devices equipped with numerous electronic components. Through SW platforms and applications, safety has improved and various convenience features are provided. This change is accelerating due to the automotive industry's megatrends of 'Connectivity (C), Autonomous (A), Sharing (S), Electrification (E)', manifesting in changes to vehicle architecture (E/E Architecture).
company.description2: High-performance CPUs are being applied to ECUs (Electronic Control Units) that run automotive software. This enables the use of applications like autonomous driving AI that require significant computing resources, and dramatically reduces the number of ECUs per vehicle from around 130. The automotive SW platform that emerged to meet these changes is the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform.
company.description3: The AUTOSAR standard is the only international standard responsible for vehicle control, consisting of Classic Platform and Adaptive Platform. Classic Platform, starting from a traditional perspective, is an SW platform emphasizing real-time capability and safety for direct control. On the other hand, Adaptive Platform is an SW platform capable of running software that uses significant computer resources, like autonomous driving AI. AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform was first applied by Volkswagen in November 2019 for mass production of the all-electric ID.3, and global automotive companies including Toyota, Hyundai, BMW, and Volvo are now accelerating its adoption.
company.description4: Just as smartphones led new businesses and ecosystems, automobiles will soon enter an era of providing new mobility services. AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform is like a catalyst for this new era of mobility services.
company.description5: PopcornSAR aims to provide an environment where developers from various fields can easily and quickly develop new mobility services based on the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform developed with our own technology. In that sense, we named our company PopcornSAR, combining Popcorn (accessible to everyone) and System ARchitecture. The new mobility service era is not a distant future but a reality that will soon be realized. PopcornSAR is preparing for the coming era and will grow as a global automotive SW platform company supporting the development of various mobility services.
